title: When to Review: Spaced Repetition for Continual Pre-Training of Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.17530v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continual pre-training of large language models must acquire new information without erasing old knowledge. Existing replay methods often choose a global old/new mixture and sample uniformly, ignoring that examples differ in how quickly they are forgotten. We formulate continual pre-training as adaptive review scheduling: the training loop should decide not only how much history to replay, but which examples should return at each step. We introduce Spaced Repetition Training (SRT), a continual learning framework inspired by cognitive science, which schedules sample-rehearsal using the SuperMemo-2 (SM-2) algorithm. SRT maintains per-example review state, maps per-example perplexity to a recall-quality signal, and schedules historical examples for retention and new examples for consolidation while leaving the model, objective, and optimizer unchanged. On temporally separated Wikipedia and code corpora, SRT improves the stability-plasticity

translated_title: 何时复习：面向语言模型持续预训练的间隔重复方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17530v1 公告类型：新论文  摘要：大型语言模型的持续预训练必须在不遗忘旧知识的前提下获取新信息。现有的重放方法通常选择全局性的新旧数据混合并均匀采样，忽略了不同样本在被遗忘速度上的差异。我们将持续预训练形式化为自适应复习调度：训练循环不仅应决定重放多少历史数据，还应决定每一步应返回哪些样本。我们引入了间隔重复训练（SRT），这是一个受认知科学启发的持续学习框架，它使用SuperMemo-2（SM-2）算法来调度样本的复述。SRT维护每个样本的复习状态，将每个样本的困惑度映射为回忆质量信号，并调度历史样本以保留知识、新样本以巩固学习，同时保持模型、目标和优化器不变。在时间分离的维基百科和代码语料库上，SRT改善了稳定性-可塑性平衡。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于认知科学中间隔重复原理的持续预训练方法，通过自适应调度历史样本的复习时机来平衡模型稳定性和可塑性，在不改变模型结构的前提下显著提升持续学习效果。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Spaced Repetition Training (SRT), a continual pre-training framework inspired by cognitive science that adaptively schedules historical sample reviews using the SuperMemo-2 algorithm, improving stability-plasticity balance without altering the model architecture.
